_why: THE CANONICAL DISPLAY NAMES FOR THE DEMO INSTANCE. One source, so no seeder
invents its own. api/scripts/demo-apply-identities.ts applies these, and
api/tests/demoIdentitiesAnonymous.test.ts stops them drifting back toward
WHY THEY ARE DELIBERATELY NOT REAL-LOOKING NAMES. The demo is the instance a
stranger can reach by scanning the poster QR. An invented name like
'Tan Wei Ming' is indistinguishable from a real UWC employee to anyone
reading the screen, so a demo that is anonymous only to people who already
know which names are fake is not anonymous at all.
REVISITED 20 AUG 2026 AND UPHELD. The owner asked for real-looking names,
then withdrew it on the argument that settles it: PRODUCTION already carries
the real driver names, and the client only ever sees production. 'Driver N'
exists solely on the demo, which is the instance strangers can reach, and
the poster is still in circulation. Anonymity costs the client nothing.
Drivers 1-8 mirror docs/uwc-spec.json's driver_assignments. Driver 9 is
demo-only: the active-trip seeder needs a driver for zone P2 and there is no
ninth in the spec. It was called 'Demo Driver P2' until 20 Aug 2026 - a
third naming convention in one list, and 'P2' is a ZONE code, not an index.
